# Getting Started with Grok: Your Guide to Everyday AI Answers

**Have you ever wanted an assistant that can help you make sense of daily news, plan your weekly tasks, or explain complex ideas in plain English?** This guide will show you how to find and use Grok, a conversational tool built by xAI, to help you navigate your day with ease.

## Before you start
- **An active X (formerly Twitter) account:** Grok lives inside the X platform, so you’ll need to be signed in.
- **A subscription plan:** Access to Grok usually requires a Premium membership on X. You can set this up from the app or the web site.

## Step 1 — Open Grok inside X
Because Grok is built into X, you don’t need a separate download.  
- **On a computer:** Look at the left‑hand navigation menu for a button that looks like a square or a slash. Click it.  
- **On a mobile device:** Open the X app, then tap the same square‑shaped icon at the bottom of the screen or inside the side menu.  

You’ll see a clean, empty chat screen ready for you to type.

💬 **Example:** Click the icon that looks like a bold square on the left side of the X web page.

## Step 2 — Pick a conversation style
Grok lets you choose how it talks to you.  
- Locate the **toggle switch** or small menu at the top of the chat window.  
- Choose **Regular Mode** for straightforward, polite answers.  
- Choose **Fun Mode** if you prefer a more playful tone.  

💬 **Example:** Switch to **Regular Mode** for your first question so the reply stays clear and focused.

## Step 3 — Send your first prompt
A **prompt** is the instruction or question you give the AI. Think of it as texting a knowledgeable friend.  
- Click the text box at the bottom of the chat, type your request, and hit send.  

💬 **Example:**  
> “I have some leftover roast chicken, half a pumpkin, and some spinach. Can you suggest a simple dinner recipe I can make in under 30 minutes?”

## Step 4 — Ask about a current event
Grok can pull in real‑time discussions from around the web.  
- Type a question about a recent topic, and Grok will summarise the latest information.  

💬 **Example:**  
> “What are the latest updates on the space mission launch from this morning? Summarise the main points in three bullet points.”

## Common mistakes
- **Not double‑checking facts:** AI can produce a **hallucination** (an answer that sounds plausible but is actually made up). Verify any critical details before acting on them.  
- **Using Fun Mode for formal tasks:** In Fun Mode the reply might include cheeky remarks. Switch back to Regular Mode for professional emails or reports.  
- **Giving up after the first answer:** If the response isn’t quite right, simply ask follow‑up questions or request a rewrite.  

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** Quickly sort out dinner ideas, decode confusing news headlines, or draft a polite message to a local business.  
- **For your business or work:** Summarise industry chatter, brainstorm social‑media captions, or get inspiration for a new project.  
- **If you're just getting started:** Keep it simple—use Grok as a friendly sounding board for the small, everyday questions that pop up.

## Try it now
Open Grok on your device, make sure you’re in **Regular Mode**, and type the following question into the chat box:

> “Explain why the sky appears blue in one clear sentence.”

Send the prompt and read the answer. You’ve just taken your first step toward using AI for everyday curiosity. Enjoy the conversation!
